behaviour: A clear, sharp, plain vinegar with no colour and little flavour beyond its sourness. It pickles, cuts through fat, sets the whites of poaching eggs and brightens a sauce. It turns harsh if it is boiled hard, so it goes in late or is cooked down on purpose.

contains.basis: Vinegar keeps a trace of the alcohol it is made from.
Recorded strictly: it may be made from grain.
Recorded strictly, as vinegars are often kept with sulphites.
